posts.subject: New !stamm rewards
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello to the Dream Community [^^*] [dgrün*] ,


After weeks of thinking and frustration as to how we can reward players with a certain amount of stamm points, I would like to put out some suggestions as to what you could do for each level (if possible). I just simply think that rewards for stamm is lacking and the users aren't getting exactly any reason as to why they should play on the server for the reason of stamm, I mean, most people don't even know what's so special about it...


Levels of Stamm - Rewards:


White - Get a leave message
Black - Get a join message, unlock access to the !store
Silver - Access to the VIP Chat (start message with a #) - I honestly don't know the difference between this and the next one:
Gold - Access to write VIP messages (start message with a *) - ...
Platinum - Get coloured smokes and grenade trails (really nice idea btw)
Diamond - Unlock Diamond trail range (so 4 different trails - emerald, amethys, ruby, sapphire diamond - shaped trails).
Final -

  • Unlock Dream Final trail (Maybe just a simple trail that says 'Final' or maybe try to be creative - I don't know the possibilities of the customization of trails but maybe you can make it change colour?)
  • I personally think this is really good - Ignore all fall damage (so when you fall off tall bridges or areas, you won't be affected by the fall damage itself).
  • AND a special message (somewhat like when a top 10 player joins the server) so a message saying something like 'Final VIP Player - Doo Doo' has joined the server.


Of course, if you have any suggestions then please enlist them on the comments below!
Thank you for reading!
~Doo Doo
